departmentNote: Departments listed here do not guarantee stock today.
correction: Report a problem or add a detail
sourceOnly: Source data has been checked; the store has not been independently verified.
historicalAccess: Historical EPA neighborhood estimate. It does not confirm an accessible route or store entrance.
matchAny: Show stores with evidence for any selected department.
scoreNote: A planning estimate, not a prediction of inventory or value.
scoreMethod: Walkability contributes 5% when available. Google ratings contribute up to 50%, weighted by n/(n+50), where n is the number of ratings. The rest uses neighborhood Census measures.
verificationMethod: We checked the operator’s website for a retail shop, address and local operator. No in-person visit.
openScore: Visit score {score} out of 100. Show score details
roundedNote: Scores and contributions are rounded for display.
